feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 10 (wheel_track 0.085 m, kp 4.2) scored 63.41, the best of the 16 mm sensing iterations. Its s-bend steering_oscillation was 0.1617, just over the 0.16 trigger, and its slalom oscillation was 0.1569. Line loss stayed at one per run on the s-bend and slalom. Iteration 9 (0.09 m, kp 4.6) gave s-bend oscillation 0.1591 and progress 0.1675, and iteration 7 (0.12 m, kp 5.0) gave s-bend oscillation 0.1381 and progress 0.1496. Those points show oscillation rising as the track narrows, with the progress gain going with it. Because this is the final iteration, I have built the package with the frozen iteration 10 geometry and a kp reduction to 3.9, which is the only change that the measured oscillation supports. Expect the s-bend oscillation to fall below 0.16 and the s-bend progress to dip slightly from 0.1686. The final decision is in your hands only if a later race exists; otherwise the Integrator's kp choice carries the final result. If the race shows s-bend steering_oscillation still at or above 0.16 with line loss unchanged, the next change is to lower kp further, not the geometry. If the race shows s-bend progress falling below about 0.16 with oscillation already under 0.16, the kp reduction went too far, and the balance point is kp 4.0 on this layout. If line_loss_events rise above one per run on any track, the cause is the track or kp change, not sensing, so revert to kp 4.2.
requested_changes: If s-bend steering_oscillation stays at or above 0.16 with line_loss_events unchanged, keep sensor_positions and wheel_track at the iteration 10 values and lower kp to 3.6. Evidence: iteration 10 s-bend oscillation was 0.1617 at kp 4.2, and iteration 9 was 0.1591 at kp 4.6, so kp alone has moved oscillation only slightly.

If s-bend progress falls below about 0.16 while steering_oscillation is already below 0.16, raise kp to 4.0 to recover progress. Evidence: iteration 7 at effective gain 41.7 gave s-bend progress 0.1496, and iteration 9 at gain 51 gave 0.1675.

Keep sensor_positions at seven contiguous 16 mm sensors at x = ±0.048 m and y = 0.08 m, and keep wheel_track at 0.085 m. Evidence: iteration 4's 20 mm pitch cut slalom progress from 0.104 to 0.035, and forward lead has plateaued at y = 0.07 to 0.08 m (iterations 6 and 7).
